searchText: Hello, I'm having trouble with spect tests vectors. I am getting an initial beacon state and a beacon block, but the beacon state has all zeroed out `BlockRoots` and I would expect the last block root to correspond to the initial beacon block's root. What am I missunderstanding? ~~Ah nevermind, I think I found already a few hacks regarding this in our own repo.~~ Ah the latest block header seems correct, yep, I was looking at the wrong place
